name: Twilio
summary: Communications APIs for messaging, voice and video.

flows.title: Look up a message in the messaging logs
steps: Log in to the Twilio Console and go to Monitor > Logs > Messaging in the left-side navigation menu.
The table lists the 50 most recent messages, newest first. Search by Message SID or by the From and To phone numbers, and filter by start and end times.
Messages whose status is not 200 show in yellow or red. Click a message's hyperlinked date to open its Message Details page, with its delivery steps, errors or warnings, and the Request Inspector.
For recommendations on one message, click its Troubleshoot button.

flows.title: Review message delivery in Messaging Insights
steps: In the Twilio Console, go to Monitor > Insights > Messaging.

Use the filter controls at the top: select a Time Range, then add criteria from the Filter by dropdowns, such as Channel, Carrier, Country, Delivery Status, Messaging Service, Error Code or Twilio number.
On the Overview dashboard, the Outgoing Messages tiles count Delivered, Delivery Unknown and Sent as Status OK, and Undelivered and Failed as Messages with Errors.
Open the Delivery & Errors dashboard to find the most common error codes behind undelivered or failed messages.
